# Digitization at the National Archives

[![National Archives and Records Administration 2022-2026 Strategic Plan](https://www.archives.gov/files/digitization/images/nara-2022-2026-strategic-plan-march-2022.png)](https://www.archives.gov/about/plans-reports/strategic-plan)

With [NARA’s strategic plan 2022-2026](https://www.archives.gov/about/plans-reports/strategic-plan), NARA has committed to digitize 500 million pages of records and make them available online to the public through the [National Archives Catalog](https://catalog.archives.gov/) by September 30, 2026. This goal will be accomplished, in part, by integrating digitization into the responsibilities of archival units nationwide and through entering into new public-private digitization partnerships.

In this section of our website, you will find:

- [Strategy for Digitizing Archival Materials for Public Access, 2018-2024](https://www.archives.gov/digitization/strategy.html)

- [List of Digitization Partnerships](https://www.archives.gov/digitization/partnerships.html)
- [List of NARA Microfilm Publications and Original Records Digitized by Our Digitization Partners](https://www.archives.gov/digitization/digitized-by-partners.html)
